title: Some generalizations of Oort's conjecture
summary: For a prime $p\geq 5$, let $\mathscr S_g$ be the moduli space over $\overline{\mathbb F}_p$ of $g$-dimensional principally polarized supersingular abelian varieties. We show that each of the following loci contains an open dense subscheme on which the principally polarized abelian varieties have automorphism group $\{\pm1\}$: (i) certain supersingular Ekedahl--Oort strata when $g$ is even, (ii) the loci in $\mathscr S_g$ with non-supersingular Ekedahl--Oort invariants of positive Coxeter type when $g\geq 3$, and (iii) the locus in $\mathscr S_g$ with $a$-number at least $2$ when $g\geq 4$.…
